profile.headline: Software Engineer at 7Factor Software
profile.summary: Freelancer and Part-time Developer at Nicely Built. I've worked with multiple clients in the Atlanta area building React & React Native solutions. Interested in remote and Atlanta based contract opportunities.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
I...
- Convert store branding and site plans to full-fledged Shopify Stores & React Native Apps
- Work with project manager and design team to determine best approaches for each client’s needs
- Build custom Javascript, Liquid and SASS/CSS solutions
- Leverage third-party apps and APIs

positions.title: React Native Developer
positions.description:
As sole developer on the project, I ...
- Translated designs to production ready React Native application
- Communicated directly with client to manage expectations for budget and timeline and to ensure exact requirements are met
- Deployed finished app to the App Store and Google Play for testing and ultimately release to public

positions.title: Front-end ReactJS/Sass Engineer
positions.description:
I ...
- Collaborated with Lead Developer to re-skin entire React/ HAML web app interpreting designer mockups to functioning code
- Built custom components to compliment existing UI

positions.title: Developer in Residence (Teaching Assistant)
positions.description:
Mentor and assist lead senior developer in educating students in HTML, CSS,
JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and React/Redux. Responsibilities include regular
student check-in’s, personalized coaching, lead an hour of instruction every Friday
covering debugging, algorithms, white-boarding, and interview prep.

positions.title: Director of Transportation
positions.description: Presenting Atlanta is a full service Destination Management Company providing groups visiting Atlanta with a complete range of services needed to create exceptional meetings.

positions.title: Online Operations
positions.description:
In 2001, Gameday Shots, a subsidiary of Baseline SportsMedia, was created as a fan photography program at the University of Georgia. Gameday Shots now has operations across the country working with the MLB, NBA, NHL, and Division I NCAA College teams. 

In September of 2010 Baseline SportsMedia was acquired by the online photo printing and backend support company Printroom Inc.

Assisting photographers by providing the backend printing, sales and support especially in the fan photography market, working with many of the leading sports and entertainment brands in the world.
